coder_notes: Temozolomide is coded soc_backbone although absent from Arm B; the investigational question is pembrolizumab with or without olaparib+TMZ. Arm B (pembrolizumab monotherapy, registered EXPERIMENTAL) works as the control for the olaparib+TMZ addition, hence control_arm_from_other_arms yes. Role of pembrolizumab in Arm B alone would be experimental_monotherapy. Window-of-opportunity surgery gives paired pre/post tumour sampling in Cohort 2.
